records.name: New Hampshire Commission on Native American Affairs
records.what: A state commission that recognizes the history and cultural contributions of Native Americans in New Hampshire and works to promote and strengthen Native heritage in the state.
records.who: Native people and anyone with a question about Native American affairs in New Hampshire.
records.start: Email the commission with your question.
records.address: Department of Natural and Cultural Resources, 172 Pembroke Road, Concord, NH 03301
